TOPIC 10.10
Alternating Series 
Error Bound

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

LIM-7.B 
Approximate the sum of a 
series. bc only

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

LIM-7.B.1 
If an alternating series converges by the 
alternating series test, then the alternating 
series error bound can be used to bound how 
far a partial sum is from the value of the infinite 
series. bc only

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

LIM-7
Applying limits may allow us to determine the finite sum of infinitely many terms.
